title: 5 Proven Tips for Healthy Hair Growth & Length Retention — Backed by Science and Salon Experience
excerpt: Healthy hair growth isn't about doing more — it's about caring for what you already have. From scalp health to protein balance, here are five practices we return to again and again with clients working towards real length retention.
body: 1. Scalp health is everything. Your scalp is the foundation from which your hair grows. A congested, irritated or unhealthy scalp can affect your hair journey. Massage your scalp regularly to encourage circulation and remove build-up. Our Pores Awakening Treatment was formulated specifically for this.

2. Protein is non-negotiable. Hair is made primarily of keratin — a protein. Include protein-rich foods such as eggs, lentils and chicken in your diet. Your hair also benefits from treatments that support strength and help maintain the protein-moisture balance.

3. Protective styles retain length. Growth happens continuously, but breakage can cancel it out. Protective styles can reduce daily manipulation and help protect your ends. Just ensure they are not too tight and that your scalp remains healthy underneath.

4. Reduce tension and manipulation. Tight hairstyles and constant manipulation can place unnecessary stress on your scalp and hairline. Choose styles that are comfortable and allow your hair to thrive. At House of Grace, we believe a hairstyle should support the health of your hair — not compromise it.

5. Be consistent with moisture and sealing. After moisturising with a lotion-based leave-in, seal with a suitable oil to help retain hydration. Consistent moisture care helps keep the hair soft, flexible and less prone to breakage — supporting your journey to healthy length retention.
At House of Grace, we believe:
Hair doesn't need to be forced. It needs to be cared for — and when you care for it, it will naturally Bloom. 🌱
